result.Method of Attack: Large-scale upload of malicious packages containing PowerShell code that downloads and executes malicious exe files
result.Discoverer: 天问Python供应链威胁监测模块
result.Impacted Systems: PyPI software source, developers using PyPI packages
result.Attack Vector: Mass automated package upload with obfuscated PowerShell code in setup.py
result.Indicators of Compromise: PowerShell code in setup.py with base64 encoding, malicious exe downloaded from third-party website, README.md mimicking urllib3
